WITH payments AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS paid
    FROM main.order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
items AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_price,
           SUM(price + freight_value) AS price_with_freight
    FROM main.order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers,
       MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase,
       MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp) IS NULL) AS invalid_timestamps,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.customer_unique_id IS NULL) AS missing_customer,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.paid IS NULL) AS missing_payment,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.item_price IS NULL) AS missing_items,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(p.paid - i.price_with_freight) > 0.01) AS payment_freight_differences,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ABS(p.paid - i.item_price) > 0.01) AS payment_price_differences,
       SUM(p.paid) AS payment_total,
       SUM(i.item_price) AS item_total,
       SUM(i.price_with_freight) AS item_and_freight_total
FROM main.orders AS o
LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

WITH order_spend AS (
    -- Customer spend is the sum of all recorded payments on each order.
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS spend
    FROM main.order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(p.spend) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(p.spend) END AS total_spend
    FROM main.orders AS o
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN order_spend AS p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
customer_recency AS (
    -- Elapsed days from the customer's latest delivered purchase to the
    -- latest delivered purchase timestamp in the dataset.
    SELECT *,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(latest_purchase) OVER ()) - JULIANDAY(latest_purchase) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_metrics
),
customer_percentiles AS (
    -- Best values sort first. CUME_DIST gives ties the same percentile.
    -- Monetary percentiles are calculated among customers with known spend.
    SELECT *,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS r_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_pct,
           CASE WHEN total_spend IS NOT NULL THEN
               CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY (total_spend IS NULL) ORDER BY total_spend DESC)
           END AS m_pct
    FROM customer_recency
),
customer_scores AS (
    -- Scores 1 through 5 use upper percentile boundaries of 20/40/60/80/100%.
    SELECT *,
           1 + (r_pct > 0.20) + (r_pct > 0.40) + (r_pct > 0.60) + (r_pct > 0.80) AS r_score,
           1 + (f_pct > 0.20) + (f_pct > 0.40) + (f_pct > 0.60) + (f_pct > 0.80)
               AS f_score,
           1 + (m_pct > 0.20) + (m_pct > 0.40) + (m_pct > 0.60) + (m_pct > 0.80) AS m_score
    FROM customer_percentiles
),
customer_segments AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, order_count, total_spend,
           CASE
               WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
               WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
               WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
               WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
               WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND fm_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
               WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
               WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
               WHEN (r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
                 OR (r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
               WHEN r_score = 1 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r_score = 2 AND fm_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r_score = 3 AND fm_score BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM (
        SELECT *, f_score + m_score AS fm_score
        FROM customer_scores
    )
),
segment_sales AS (
    -- Dividing segment spend by segment orders weights each order equally.
    SELECT rfm_segment, SUM(total_spend) / SUM(order_count) AS average_sales_per_order
    FROM customer_segments
    GROUP BY rfm_segment
)
SELECT s.rfm_segment, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(cs.order_count) AS orders,
       ROUND(s.average_sales_per_order, 2) AS average_sales_per_order
FROM segment_sales AS s
JOIN customer_segments AS cs ON cs.rfm_segment IS s.rfm_segment
GROUP BY s.rfm_segment, s.average_sales_per_order
ORDER BY s.average_sales_per_order DESC, s.rfm_segment

           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,

           n.pizza_name,

           o.exclusions,
           o.extras
    FROM main.pizza_clean_customer_orders AS o
    JOIN main.pizza_names AS n ON n.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
    LEFT JOIN main.pizza_recipes AS r ON r.pizza_id = o.pizza_id
),
topping_lists AS (
    SELECT row_id, 'recipe' AS kind, toppings AS ids FROM pizza_orders
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id, 'exclusion', exclusions FROM pizza_orders
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id, 'extra', extras FROM pizza_orders
),
split_toppings(row_id, kind, token, remaining) AS (
    SELECT row_id, kind, '', ids || ','
    FROM topping_lists
    WHERE ids IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id,
           kind,
           TRIM(SUBSTR(remaining, 1, INSTR(remaining, ',') - 1)),
           SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1)
    FROM split_toppings
    WHERE remaining <> ''
),
topping_ids AS (
    SELECT row_id, kind, CAST(token AS INTEGER) AS topping_id
    FROM split_toppings
    WHERE token <> ''
),
final_toppings AS (
    SELECT r.row_id, r.topping_id
    FROM topping_ids AS r
    WHERE r.kind = 'recipe'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM topping_ids AS e
          WHERE e.kind = 'exclusion'
            AND e.row_id = r.row_id
            AND e.topping_id = r.topping_id
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT row_id, topping_id
    FROM topping_ids
    WHERE kind = 'extra'
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT f.row_id, t.topping_name, COUNT(*) AS topping_count
    FROM final_toppings AS f
    JOIN main.pizza_toppings AS t ON t.topping_id = f.topping_id
    GROUP BY f.row_id, t.topping_name
)
SELECT o.row_id,
       o.order_id,
       o.customer_id,
       o.pizza_name,
       o.pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE(
           GROUP_CONCAT(
               CASE WHEN i.topping_count > 1 THEN '2x' || i.topping_name

               ', ' ORDER BY (i.topping_count > 1) DESC,
                             i.topping_name COLLATE NOCASE

ORDER BY o.row_id ASC

WITH season_rounds AS (
    SELECT r.year, MAX(r.round) AS final_round
    FROM main.races AS r
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year
),
standings AS (
    SELECT r.year, ds.driver_id, ds.points
    FROM main.driver_standings AS ds
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = ds.race_id
    JOIN season_rounds AS sr ON sr.year = r.year AND sr.final_round = r.round
),
event_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id, res.points, 'race' AS source
    FROM main.results AS res
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, sp.driver_id, sp.constructor_id, sp.points, 'sprint' AS source
    FROM main.sprint_results AS sp
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = sp.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
),
event_totals AS (
    SELECT ep.year, ep.driver_id, SUM(ep.points) AS all_points,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ep.source = 'race' THEN ep.points ELSE 0 END) AS race_points
    FROM event_points AS ep
    GROUP BY ep.year, ep.driver_id
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT et.year,
           SUM(CASE WHEN et.all_points > 0 AND s.driver_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_missing_standings,
           SUM(CASE WHEN et.all_points != s.points THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differences,
           MIN(CASE WHEN s.points > 0 THEN s.points END) AS standings_min,
           MIN(CASE WHEN et.all_points > 0 THEN et.all_points END) AS all_event_min,
           MIN(CASE WHEN et.race_points > 0 THEN et.race_points END) AS race_only_min
    FROM event_totals AS et
    LEFT JOIN standings AS s ON s.year = et.year AND s.driver_id = et.driver_id
    GROUP BY et.year
)
SELECT cmp.*,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ep.points > 0 THEN ep.driver_id END) AS min_drivers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ep.points > 0 THEN ep.constructor_id END) AS min_scoring_constructors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ep.constructor_id) AS min_drivers_all_constructors
FROM comparison AS cmp
JOIN event_totals AS et ON et.year = cmp.year AND et.all_points = cmp.all_event_min
JOIN event_points AS ep ON ep.year = et.year AND ep.driver_id = et.driver_id
GROUP BY cmp.year
ORDER BY cmp.year
